prompts.title: Impasto Portrait in Shades of Purple
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for the female face and identity reference. Preserve the same facial identity, facial structure, facial proportions, age, skin tone, and natural likeness accurately. Do not copy the reference image’s clothing, pose, background, hairstyle, accessories, lighting, or environment. Only the face and identity should change according to the uploaded female reference; everything else must follow the prompt exactly.
Create an ultra-detailed 3D sculptural portrait rendered in a heavy impasto tactile style, blending hyper-realistic 3D rendering with thick oil paint textures. The subject is a beautiful young woman shown in a serene left-facing side profile, with her head gently tilted downward and a calm, introspective expression.
She has dark, glossy hair tied back in a loose, slightly messy ponytail, with a few soft strands falling naturally around her face. Her skin has a smooth, subtle glow, enhanced with soft pink makeup and softly tinted pink lips. She delicately holds a small bouquet of vivid purple flowers in both hands close to her chest, creating a quiet, emotional, contemplative mood.
She wears a simple white sleeveless tank top with minimal detailing, painted with thick visible brush strokes to enhance the tactile sculptural quality.
Environment and Composition:
The subject must appear strictly as a mural painted on a vertical wall surface. The artwork is clearly confined within the wall boundaries and must not extend onto the ground, sidewalk, or any horizontal surface.
The wall behind her is a rich lavender-purple tone with visible plaster texture, expressive palette-knife marks, and thick impasto brush strokes. Above her, a lush canopy of vibrant purple bougainvillea flowers spreads across the top of the frame, growing from a slender, slightly curved tree trunk on the left side.
Subtle fallen petals are scattered along the real ground at the base of the wall, adding realism and depth. The composition is vertically framed from mid-torso up, with the woman placed slightly right of center so the tree trunk and floral canopy balance the frame naturally.
The ground below must remain real, unpainted, and separate from the mural, showing a natural sidewalk surface with a few scattered petals. No part of the painted woman, flowers, clothing, or brush strokes should overlap onto the ground.
Camera and Perspective:
Eye-level camera angle, straight-on perspective. The wall must be perfectly vertical and parallel to the camera sensor, with no tilt, distortion, warped perspective, or perspective skew.
Lighting:
Bright, direct natural sunlight comes from the upper right, creating strong highlights and sharp dramatic shadows. The bougainvillea flowers cast intricate dappled shadows across the lavender wall, the woman’s face, neck, shoulder, and tank top. The lighting should strongly emphasize the thickness, depth, and direction of every impasto brush stroke.
Style and Texture:
Highly tactile sculptural impasto style with exaggerated visible paint strokes across the skin, clothing, flowers, hair, and background. The final image should feel like a fusion of thick oil painting, 3D sculpture, and hyper-realistic rendering — dimensional, premium, cinematic, and almost touchable.
Technical Details:
8K resolution, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, Octane Render, global illumination, high dynamic range, masterpiece quality, ultra-realistic textures, premium 3D oil-paint mural aesthetic.
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Impasto Reflection
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, contemporary impasto oil portrait based strictly on the provided reference image. Face + identity must match the reference correctly — preserve precise bone structure, eye shape, nose proportions, lip shape/fullness, jawline, cheekbone structure, facial symmetry, skin tone, and overall likeness.

Pose & Framing
Head Pose: Perfectly front-facing, upright head position with no tilt or rotation. Chin level and centered. The face is aligned vertically with the frame’s center axis. Direct, steady eye contact with the viewer. Expression calm and neutral.
Neck & Body Pose: Visible neck fully exposed. Shoulders relaxed and naturally dropped. Upper squared to camera. No dramatic twist. Body posture elegant and elongated, creating a vertical flow from chest to crown.
Framing: Tight vertical close-up portrait. Cropped just below the upper shoulder area and slightly above the top of the hair. Head occupies majority of the frame height. Symmetrical centered composition with equal negative space on both sides. Minimal background dominance — subject clearly foregrounded.
Camera Angle: Strict eye-level, classic studio portrait alignment. No distortion, no low/high angle exaggeration.
Focal Priority: Maximum sharpness and detail around eyes, nose bridge, and lips; painterly falloff toward outer hair edges and lower neck.
Artistic Style & Technique
Paint in bold contemporary impasto style with thick, sculptural paint application. Use heavy palette-knife marks and wide stiff-brush strokes. Keep strokes broken and gestural (no smooth airbrushed blending). The paint surface must look physically layered and 3D.
Add thick raised “dollops” of white/cream paint on the forehead (central upper area), cheeks, nose bridge, and chin so highlights appear tactile and catch light naturally.
Color Palette & Lighting
Background: cool muted teal / seafoam backdrop with subtle tonal variation and visible brush texture.
Skin tones: complex mosaic of earthy tones — burnt sienna, ochre, coral, rose pink, warm beige — plus small accents of soft yellow and hints of cool sky-blue undertones.
Hair: deep brown rendered with broad sweeping strokes, slightly loose and imperfect. Add bold flashes of cadmium yellow and bright white near the upper sections to suggest reflected light and artistic accent strokes.
Lighting direction: from the upper-left. Strong impasto highlights on left forehead, cheekbone, nose bridge, and upper lip. Softer warm shadows on the right side of the face.
Subject Expression & Features
Neutral yet intense expression. Lips softly parted with natural fullness. Calm, poised, introspective mood.
Eyes are the sharpest area: piercing seafoam green/blue with crisp white catchlights; high realism even within painterly texture.
Edge Work & Integration
Let edges of hair and shoulders softly bleed into the background using thin, wispy strokes so the subject blends naturally into the teal space rather than appearing cut-out. Maintain visible canvas grain and authentic oil paint thickness throughout.
Output: 1:1 aspect ratio, ultra-detailed, gallery-quality oil painting look, photographed in studio light, 8K resolution, sharp texture, rich impasto depth.
